Getting started

From your account
to your first session.

Use the web app on your computer and the Android app on the phone you want to help with.

  1. 01

    Open the web app

    Create your account or sign in. You can open the app directly from a shared link. For password recovery, add and verify your email address.

  2. 02

    Pair the phone

    Install the Android app, enter the server address and a pairing code from the web app, then choose a separate device password. Enable the accessibility service on the phone.

  3. 03

    Start helping

    When the phone appears online, enter its device password and open a session. View the screen, tap, swipe and type in supported fields.

Set it up together, once

Screen viewing requires Android 11 or newer. The phone must be online, unlocked, with the accessibility service running and remote control enabled. Setup needs the device user’s permission; no new approval is required for each session.

If Android stops the service or the phone locks, someone may need to act on the device. App and device restrictions still apply.

How connections work

Know where
your session goes.

The server connects you

Screen images and commands pass through the RemotePocket server between your browser and the phone.

Choose who runs the server

The hosted service uses a server operated by RemotePocket. With your own installation, you choose and manage the server.

Account and activity data

The server stores accounts, paired devices and activity history to operate the service. Review the service’s data information before using the hosted app.
